newsitem.title: UK: Dollar/yen firm in Europe in aftermath of G7 Summi.
newsitem.headline: Dollar/yen firm in Europe in aftermath of G7 Summi.

text.p: The dollar motored more than one yen higher in early Europe to peaks around 115.67 yen in the wake of the G7 summit, which downplayed US-Japan trade friction and generally broke little new ground, said analysts.

"Basically, they (G7) downplayed trade friction between the U.S. and Japan and instead the U.S. put the emphasis on increased deregulation by Japanese authorities," said Nick Stamenkovic, economist at DKB International. Markets had been expecting the U.S. to use the G7 meeting in Denver, which ended on Sunday, as a platform to target Japan's ballooning trade surplus with the U.S.
